Maria: Heads-up — incoming external assessment retest. Need to lock an evidence corridor and finalize RBAC/KMS gating. Proposed window: Tue 2025-04-29 09:00-13:00 PT. Thoughts? @derek @sarah
Derek: Tue works for infra. Are we doing ephemeral KMS proxy or granting assessor a readroom key? Also need a list of resources they'll access.
Sarah: Prefer ephemeral proxy + restricted read-only IAM. Limits to: secrets manager read for certs, s3:ListBucket+GetObject for evidence bucket, CloudTrail read-only. We'll need audit sampling enabled.
Lee: Quick note — Dedicated infra will require a short maintenance action to open the corridor (security group tweak). Need an owner and a rollback plan.
Maria: Owner: Derek. Rollback: undo sg change + revoke ephemeral role. @derek can you add the RBAC diff to the ticket?
Derek: On it. Draft IAM snippet below:
```
Role: assessor-ephemeral
Policies:
- kms:Decrypt (resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/evidence-key)
- s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket (resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*)
- logs:FilterLogEvents (resource: arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:111122223333:log-group:/aws/*)
Condition: aws:RequestTag/assessor:true
```
I'll attach to SEC-2314.
Jordan: Audit retention question — do we need longer retention for this window? Compliance wants 90 days for any red-team activity.
Maria: Yeah set audit retention to 90 days for involved streams. Also enable high-sampling for CloudTrail and ELB logs for the 48h window around the test.
Tony: KMS proxy detail — we can proxy decrypts through a short-lived GRPC service that only returns plaintext to the readroom VM. Works with HSM-backed key. Needs network ACLs.
Sarah: +1 for KMS proxy. Saves us from granting direct kms:Decrypt. But we must capture proof of key use in logs. Add request-id tagging.
Derek: Plan for evidence ingestion: assessor drops artifacts into s3 under /incoming/<assessor-id> with gpg-signed manifests. We run a lambda to snapshot and checksum and move to /sealed/<id>.
Maria: Can we get a dry-run Friday? Derek — can you schedule with Eng-SRE? @eng-sre
eng-sre-bot: @derek scheduled dry-run: Fri 2025-04-25 14:00 PT — runbook created SEC-2314-DRY
Derek: Ack. I'll post RBAC diff and the KMS-proxy config in the ticket. Anyone object to the proposed window?
Jordan: No objections from compliance. Make sure to include alerting for anomalous key usage.
Lee: I'll own rollback automation. Will create a runbook snippet and link it.
Maria: Perfect. After dry-run, we'll confirm and invite assessor to the readroom. Thanks all :thumbsup:
eng-sre-bot: Ticket SEC-2314 updated with artifacts: /tickets/SEC-2314
